lines.trans: None of this is your fault.
I just feel terrible toward everyone on your crew.

meanings.note: Standard gender-neutral 'I' in polite and business Japanese.
Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: Standard heartfelt apology.

examples.text: ごめんなさい、もうしません。
examples.trans: I'm sorry, I won't do it again.

meanings.note: Second-person pronoun used by superiors, in songs/books, or between close friends.

examples.text: 君の意見はどうですか。
君ならきっとできるよ。

meanings.en: short casual form of じゃあ / では
meanings.note: Brisk spoken transition before taking the next step.
Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.
Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Polite way to address a group of people.

examples.text: 皆さんにお知らせがあります。
examples.trans: I have an announcement for everyone.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.

meanings.en: justification (申し訳ございません = no excuse / deeply sorry)
meanings.note: Paired with ございません or ありません for formal apologies.

examples.text: 遅れて申し訳ございません。
examples.trans: I am deeply sorry for being late.

examples.text: 大変申し訳ありませんでした。

meanings.note: Read なん before だ/です/の, and なに before が/を or alone.

examples.text: 何を買いにきましたか。
examples.trans: What did you come to buy?

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.

examples.text: 何というのか…君はすごかった。俺は完全にのみ込まれてしまったよ。
examples.trans: How do I put it... you were extraordinary. I was completely swept away by you.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Auxiliary godan verb following て-form.

examples.text: つい忘れてしまいました。
本を全部読んでしまった。
examples.trans: I finished reading the whole book.

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.note: Can stand at the head of a sentence without a particle ('right now').

meanings.en: nothing more than (after past verb); up to
meanings.note: After a plain verb + です (出店したまでです), modestly states 'we simply did that and nothing more'.

examples.text: 念のため聞いたまでです。
examples.trans: I merely asked just in case.

meanings.en: to think; to feel; to believe
meanings.note: Often follows quotative と to express an opinion or belief.

examples.text: それはいいと思います。
俺が今まで思ってた女性像とまるで違う、初めての感覚だった。
examples.trans: It shattered every image of women I held until now — a sensation I'd never felt in my life.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Alone as 違う！ or 違います, means 'No, that's wrong!'.

examples.text: 俺が今まで思ってた女性像とまるで違う、初めての感覚だった。
examples.trans: It shattered every image of women I held until now — a sensation I'd never felt in my life.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

examples.text: 監督が扉を開けてくれたから、あの時自分を肯定できたんです。
examples.trans: Because you opened that door for me, Director, I was able to embrace who I truly am.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.

meanings.en: do a favor for the speaker
meanings.note: After a te-form (会ってくれる？), warmly asks 'will you do that for us?'

examples.trans: Will you come again for me?

examples.text: 母が料理を作ってくれました。
examples.trans: My mother cooked food for me.

meanings.note: Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Filler or polite attention-getter.

examples.text: あの、ちょっとよろしいですか。
examples.trans: Excuse me, do you have a moment?

examples.text: あの、実は相談があります。
examples.trans: Um, actually I have something to ask you.

meanings.note: Reflexive pronoun pointing back to the person under discussion.

examples.text: 自分の言葉で話します。
examples.trans: I speak in my own words.

examples.text: 監督が扉を開けてくれたから、あの時自分を肯定できたんです。
examples.trans: Because you opened that door for me, Director, I was able to embrace who I truly am.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

できる.gloss: be built; open; be able to

meanings.en: come into existence; be completed; can do
meanings.note: With buildings or stores (店ができる), means a new shop has been built or opened.

examples.text: 駅前に新しいカフェができました。
examples.trans: A new café opened in front of the station.

examples.text: 日本語が少しできます。
examples.trans: I can speak a little Japanese.

meanings.note: Directly modifies a noun near the speaker (この店, この辺, この部分).

examples.text: この本は人気があります。

meanings.note: Everyday noun for one's job or workplace duties.

examples.text: 新しい仕事は楽しいです。
これから仕事に行きます。
examples.trans: I am heading to work now.

meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.note: Before an adjective (一番近い), forms the superlative ('closest').

examples.trans: This one is the most popular.

examples.text: 一番近い駅はどこですか。
この仕事してきて、一番のご褒美だったかもしれないな。
examples.trans: In all my time doing this work, that may have been my greatest reward.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Short for かもしれない; expresses possibility or uncertainty.
Ichidan verb; most commonly appears in the set expression かもしれない ('might be').

examples.text: 遅れるかもしれません。
本当かもしれませんよ。
examples.trans: It might be true, you know.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
Irregular i-adjective whose past/conditional stems use よ- (よかったら).

examples.text: よかったら来てください。

meanings.en: from now on; in the future; now
meanings.note: Time expression referring to the immediate or upcoming future.

examples.text: これから家へ帰ります。

examples.trans: The real test starts from here.

meanings.note: Asks about condition, outcome (どうだった), or what happened (どうしましたか).
Prompts someone into action or shoos them along.
Adverb.

examples.text: まだ終わっていません。

meanings.note: Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.note: Ichidan verb; potential form 決められる means 'can decide'.

examples.text: まだ何も決めていません。
今決められないなら、後で考えましょう。
examples.trans: If you can't decide now, let's think about it later.

meanings.note: I-adjective; after て-form (～てほしい), means 'want someone to do something'.

examples.trans: I want you to come soon.

examples.text: 諦めてほしくないのです。
examples.trans: I don't want you to give up.

meanings.note: Conjunctive particle giving a reason, softer than から.

examples.text: 雨が降っているので、家にいます。
examples.trans: Since it's raining, I'm staying home.

examples.text: 時間がないので急ぎましょう。
examples.trans: We don't have time, so let's hurry.

meanings.note: Na-adjective stem (also used adverbially).

examples.text: 時間は十分にあります。

meanings.note: Standard polite 'goodbye'.
